title: notes
text:
don’t change index.qmd name
_quarto.yml - structure and metadata of website
can use quarto preview in the terminal to check current version of site
to rename branch name in your repo usethis::git_default_branch_rename(from = "master", to = "main")
to always use branch name of master, change your git config: usethis::use_git_config(init.defaultBranch = "main"). check that it’s changed in your terminal git config --list
site/ is where rendered html is, but you don’t make changes there (you make changes in the quarto docs), though we will rename it because GH pages only knows to look in the root directory or a folder called docs. Add this to _quarto.yml.
created a blank file called .nojekyll that disables some GH pages automatic formatting
